messages:
Riley: Quick report - sample-app showing duplicate writes when token refresh races with retries. Repro steps below.

Riley: Repro: set short token TTL, send 4 concurrent POST /cart calls. Sometimes two writes land.

Riley: Observed trace:
```
call1 POST /cart -> 401
SDK starts refresh (no lock)
call2 POST /cart -> 401
SDK refresh completes
call1 retry -> 200
call2 retry -> 200
```
No Idempotency-Key in sample.

Alice: Sounds like we need a refresh coordinator. Node currently lets many refreshes run.

Samir: Also need to adjust retry policy for unsafe ops: exponential backoff + jitter and stricter caps on retries if body present and no idempotency key.

Nora: Proposal: 1) single refresh promise per process; waiters await that promise. 2) For POST/PUT without Idempotency-Key, only one retry after refresh and emit warning. 3) Implement backoff: base*2^n +/- 25% jitter, clamp 50ms-3s, total timeout 10s.

QA Runner: I'll add e2e that sets TTL=300ms and asserts single persisted write for 8 concurrent requests. Also add a 429 flood test to validate jitter.

CI Bot: Noted - samples/post_race_test flaky count increased. Tagging @Alice @Samir.

Alice: I'll open small PR for refresh promise + unit tests. Will keep behavior backwards compatible except fewer duplicate retries.

Samir: I'll add shared backoff helper behind feature flag. We should log when we downgrade retries for unsafe calls so customers know.

Riley: Thanks. If we default sample app to generate Idempotency-Key for writes that will help newcomers too. Nora can update examples.

Nora: Will update quickstart and add snippet showing Idempotency-Key usage.

Riley: Action items: Alice PR (refresh lock), Samir backoff helper, Nora sample/idempotency change, QA e2e. Follow-up tomorrow.
